name: Sunteck Realty Ltd
title: Sunteck Realty Ltd - 512179 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Real estate developer with no capacity utilisation or supply-discipline metric; H1 presales +19% YoY, management reiterates 25% FY27 presales guidance on a H2-weighted INR7,000 cr launch pipeline, while BD spend rose to ~INR400 cr in H1.

triggers.quote: still we could achieve a 19% year-on-year growth in H1

triggers.label: FY27 presales 25% reiterated
triggers.quote: our guidance or our expectation of 25% year-on-year growth in the full year of FY '27, we will be able to maintain easily

triggers.label: BD spend INR3.9 bn in H1
triggers.quote: This surplus was delivered investing INR3.9 billion in business development during the half.

guidance.quote: we will be able to maintain easily

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are looking at a growth of 25%, which we are, again, very confident

red_flags.label: Dubai GDV removed from to-be-launched
red_flags.quote: we have moved the Dubai project from to be launched GDV to upcoming for-launch GDV

red_flags.label: Collections lag presales
red_flags.quote: As recent sales are weighted towards early stage projects where milestones-linked collections are back-ended.

red_flags.label: Nepean Sea Road launch timing pressure
red_flags.quote: we are looking to launch with RERA as early -- definitely before end of FY '27

evasions.topic: Borivali land and Mira Road project GDV history
evasions.quote: Last quarter, we announced maybe the Mira Road project. We have taken up from the -- we have taken -- removed from -- we have moved it in GDV.

summary.headline: Sunteck H1 FY27 PAT up 20% to INR1 billion and operating cash surplus up 27% to INR3.5 billion; FY27 presales growth target of 25% reiterated.
summary.overview: Management reported H1 FY27 revenue up 16% to INR5.1 billion, EBITDA up 23% to INR1.6 billion and PAT up 20% to INR1 billion, with embedded EBITDA margin at 30%. Q2 presales were INR824 crores (H1 INR1,611 crores) and Q2 collections INR371 crores (H1 INR780 crores). The company added a 4.5-acre Borivali West parcel, taking that assembled site to 11.5 acres and total GDV to INR469 billion, and moved the Dubai project out of the to-be-launched GDV. Management says H2 is weighted towards launches, with an FY27 pipeline of INR70 billion excluding Dubai.

financial_highlights.metric: H1 net operating cash flow surplus

segments.name: Presales mix (Q2)
segments.commentary: Uber luxury 25% (management also cited 27% in Q&A), premium luxury 51% (50% in Q&A), aspirational luxury 25% (23% in Q&A). Aspirational uptick seen at Naigaon and Kalyan projects.

segments.name: Business development
segments.commentary: H1 business development spend about INR3.9 billion (about INR400 crores per Q&A); FY26 spend about INR800 crores. Borivali West now 11.5 acres, estimated GDV INR80 billion.

segments.name: Annuity income
segments.commentary: Annualised run-rate INR86 crores against INR76 crores in FY26.

guidance_outlook: FY27 presales growth guidance of 25% YoY reiterated; H1 presales growth was 19% with no major launches.
FY27 launch pipeline excluding Dubai of INR70 billion, weighted to H2.

H2 launches: Sunteck Belvedere Park (Mira Road, GDV INR1,200-1,400 crores), Andheri Western Express Highway redevelopment (GDV INR1,250-1,500 crores), Altavia Tower 2 at ODC, Borivali West phase, new towers at SBR, Sunteck World and Sunteck Crescent Park; total pipeline about INR7,000 crores.
Nepean Sea Road (about INR3,000 crores GDV) targeted for RERA launch before end FY27; demolition of buildings under way.
Dubai project moved from to-be-launched to upcoming GDV as launch visibility is not seen in the next 1-2 quarters.
capex_capacity: Borivali West assembled land now 11.5 acres (7 acres plus 4.5 acres bought outright this quarter), described as one contiguous project; total GDV INR469 billion, of which INR260 billion launched or to be launched.
Sunteck Sky Park: higher floors added to Towers 1-3 under new FSI policy, equivalent to one new tower; GDV about INR750 crores, Q2 sales about INR200 crores.

Completions expected in FY27: Sunteck One World Naigaon, ODC Avenue 1 higher floors, 4th Avenue (construction started, large floor count), Sunteck Pinnacle commercial project (recently completing), and ready inventory at BKC.
Altavia (ODC): Tower 1 under construction; Tower 2 launch and construction start planned in H2; commercial building under construction.
Project-level EBITDA margin filter of 30-35% and high IRR and equity multiple applied to all acquisitions; deals across JDA, JV, redevelopment and outright purchase models.
demand_pricing: Uber luxury demand driven by BKC sales, where inventory is diminishing; larger uber luxury run expected from Nepean Sea Road.
Presales mix is highly weighted to early-stage projects, so milestone-linked collections are back-ended.
Management expects the high embedded EBITDA margin of presales to flow into reported margins as projects reach revenue recognition.
Management says reported margins will continue to converge towards the 30% embedded EBITDA margin.

qa_highlights.question: What are the H2 launches and their GDV, including Mira Road and Andheri?
qa_highlights.answer: Mira Road 2 (Belvedere Park) GDV about INR1,200-1,400 crores; Andheri West about INR1,250-1,500 crores; the total H2 pipeline including Altavia Tower 2, Borivali West, SBR, Sunteck World and Crescent Park is about INR7,000 crores.

qa_highlights.question: What is the segment mix and full-year presales outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Mix is uber luxury 27%, premium luxury 50%, aspirational luxury 23%. Management reiterated 25% FY27 presales growth, citing H1 growth of 19% and the INR7,000 crore launch pipeline.

qa_highlights.question: Is the new Borivali land contiguous with the earlier parcel and will it launch soon?
qa_highlights.answer: Yes, the 4.5 acres adjoins the existing 7 acres and will be one consolidated 11.5-acre project; management said it intends to launch soon but did not give a date.

qa_highlights.question: Update on the ODC commercial project and Altavia construction?
qa_highlights.answer: Construction has started on the commercial building and on one residential tower; Altavia Tower 2 is planned for launch and construction start in H2 FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Will business development continue, given the large pipeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Yes; net debt is 0.09 times equity, about INR800 crores was spent on BD in FY26 and about INR400 crores in H1; 1-2 deals are at an advanced stage, with the 30-35% margin filter retained.

qa_highlights.question: Nepean Sea Road approval status and RERA launch timing?
qa_highlights.answer: Approvals are at an advanced stage; demolition of the second building is due to finish in 10-15 days and a third/fourth building demolition is starting; the company aims to launch under RERA before end FY27. GDV is about INR3,000 crores.

qa_highlights.question: Sky Park new phase: area and GDV?
qa_highlights.answer: Clarified as higher floors on Towers 1-3 under new FSI, equivalent to one new tower; total GDV about INR750 crores, with about INR200 crores sold in Q2.

qa_highlights.question: Which projects complete in FY27 to drive revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Sunteck One World Naigaon, ODC Avenue 1 higher floors, 4th Avenue, Sunteck Pinnacle commercial and ready BKC and other inventory; management expects H2 to be strong.

risks_watch: Dubai project removed from to-be-launched GDV, with no launch visibility in the next 1-2 quarters.
Presales growth depends on H2 launches of about INR7,000 crores; H1 presales growth was 19% against a 25% full-year target.
Nepean Sea Road RERA launch before end FY27 depends on demolition and approvals; a delay would hit the uber luxury ramp-up.
Collections lag as recent sales are weighted to early-stage projects with back-ended milestones.
Borivali West had a question on the older land parcel status and a prior-quarter Mira Road GDV reclassification; management's answers on these were not fully clear.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on growth, launch pipeline and balance sheet, with firm assurances on the 25% presales target and the Nepean Sea Road timeline. Answers were sometimes repetitive or unclear on segment-mix figures, GDV reclassifications and the Borivali parcel history.
key_quotes: We have delivered a strong first half with growth across presales, collections, cash flows, revenue and profits, sustaining the CAGR of 25% across all major operational and financial parameters over the last 5 years.
Every new acquisition must clear the same filters we have always applied, a high IRR, a high equity multiple and a minimum project level EBITDA margins of 30% to 35%.
Reported margins will continue to converge towards the embedded EBITDA margin of our presales.
we are very, very confident that our guidance or our expectation of 25% year-on-year growth in the full year of FY '27, we will be able to maintain easily.

adds.what: Sunteck Sky Park higher floors on Towers 1-3 under new FSI policy (equivalent to one new tower), GDV about INR750 crores
Borivali West assembled site expanded to 11.5 acres (4.5 acres added this quarter), estimated GDV INR80 billion

growth.why: Management reiterated 25% FY27 presales growth (a presales metric, not revenue) with H1 presales only +19% and no major launches; backing is a INR70 billion H2-weighted launch pipeline (Belvedere Park, Western Express Highway redevelopment, Nepean Sea Road targeted before FY27 end) and 4.5 acres added at Borivali West, but no firm launch dates or sales commitments were quantified beyond these.
